name: @feimacode/open-design-agent-kit-desktop-extension
description: Builds the Open Design Claude Desktop extension (open-design-<version>.mcpb): the MCP server bundled with its SDK and the vendored content, run on Claude Desktop's own Node. The .mcpb takes packages/mcp-server's version; this package is never published, and the .mcpb is attached to each GitHub release.
